title: Summably L¹-Cauchy integer multiplicity densities have an integer multiplicity weak limit (Simon 3.13, printed (2)–(3))
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and H := μHE[k] on ℝ^N. For p ∈ ℕ let (M_p, θ_p, ξ_p) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple ℝ^N k M_p θ_p ξ_p, with θ_p natural-valued on M_p (∀ x ∈ M_p, ∃ m ∈ ℕ, θ_p(x) = m), and put κ_p := M_p.indicator(θ_p • ξ_p) : ℝ^N → Λ_k(ℝ^N) (NVector (Eucl N) k). Assume Σ_p ∫ |κ_{p+1} − κ_p| dH < ∞, where |w| := (Σ_γ w(dx^γ)²)^{1/2} for a k-vector w, the sum running over the strictly increasing multi-indices γ ∈ SimonMultiIndex k N (dx^γ = wedgeCovectors k (proj ∘ γ), w(dx^γ) = euclideanNVectorCoordinate w γ). Precisely: the [0, ∞]-valued series Σ_p ∫⁻ ENNReal.ofReal(|κ_{p+1}(x) − κ_p(x)|) dH(x) is ≠ ∞. Then there are M₀ ⊆ ℝ^N, θ₀ : ℝ^N → ℝ and ξ₀ : ℝ^N → Λ_k(ℝ^N) such that IsRectifiableTriple ℝ^N k M₀ θ₀ ξ₀ holds, θ₀ is natural-valued on M₀, and for every continuous compactly supported k-form ω : ℝ^N → Λ^k(ℝ^N), tauAction k M_p θ_p ξ_p ω → tauAction k M₀ θ₀ ξ₀ ω as p → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (M : ℕ → Set (Eucl N)) (θ : ℕ → Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), (∀ p, IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k (M p) (θ p) (ξ p)) → (∀ p, ∀ x ∈ M p, ∃ m : ℕ, θ p x = m) → (∑' p, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (∑ γ : SimonMultiIndex k N, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate ((M (p + 1)).indicator (fun y => θ (p + 1) y • ξ (p + 1) y) x - (M p).indicator (fun y => θ p y • ξ p y) x) γ) ^ 2)) ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) ≠ ∞ → ∃ (M₀ : Set (Eucl N)) (θ₀ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ₀ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k M₀ θ₀ ξ₀ ∧ (∀ x ∈ M₀, ∃ m : ℕ, θ₀ x = m) ∧ ∀ ω : Eucl N → Covector (Eucl N) k, Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → Tendsto (fun p => tauAction k (M p) (θ p) (ξ p) ω) atTop (𝓝 (tauAction k M₀ θ₀ ξ₀ ω))
